html:
An Italian friar and saint from Assisi who gave up his wealth to live in poverty and founded the Franciscan order. He was born Giovanni di Pietro di Bernardone, son of a rich cloth merchant.

As a young man he fought in a war against Perugia and was held prisoner. After illness and visions he turned from his old life. In a famous scene he stripped off his clothes before the bishop and handed them back to his angry father. He begged, cared for lepers, rebuilt ruined chapels and preached to ordinary people in plain words. Followers gathered, and around 1209 Pope Innocent III approved his simple rule.

He called animals and the sun his brothers and sisters, and his Canticle of the Sun is one of the first great poems in Italian. In 1219, during the Fifth Crusade, he crossed to Egypt and met the sultan al-Kamil.

The Franciscans, and the Dominicans of Thomas Aquinas, were new orders of friars who preached in Europe's growing towns. Dante praised him in Paradise, and Pope Francis took his name in 2013.
sum: An Italian friar and saint from Assisi who gave up his wealth to live in poverty and founded the Franciscan order. He was born Giovanni di Pietro di Bernardone, son of a rich cloth merchant.
